# Coverage by the Number of Early-Breakout Batches: the Test of Record

Coverage of the test of record's core cells, split by the number of type-C5 batches on one side. Description only; the experiments are the record's own and nothing is adjusted. Every number is made up.

Seed 20261006, the amended generator; the judged sample of each cell (2,000 experiments, or the rerun's 10,000 where the cell was rerun), reproduced from the committed report and checked against it cell by cell. An early-breakout batch is one drawn as the pilot's type C5, whose own-search harm at 20 steps is twice the other types'. A side of 16 holds none with probability (7/8)^16 = 11.8 percent, one with 27.0 percent, two with 28.9 percent, three or more with 32.3 percent.
